title: 'Accept and book' on the shared quote page: one tap marks the lead won, holds or confirms the seats of a linked departure, creates the invoice when configured and offers the deposit payment
goal: A customer reading the quote link accepts it on the page; staff find the lead won, the seats held (or confirmed), the invoice ready and, if a gateway is connected, the deposit being paid.
why: Gap 10: the shared quote page has no accept button and acceptance comes back by message. Design: TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md sections 4.6, 5.5 and 13.3.

edit: backend/src/routes/itineraries.ts (accepted fields in GET and a staff 'mark accepted' only)

steps: 0063: itineraries ADD accepted_at, accepted_via, accepted_name, accepted_ip_hash (SHA-256 of IP + tenant id, never the raw IP); schema; bundle.

GET /public/quotation/:token additionally returns {accept: {enabled, label, requireName, requireTerms, state: open|accepted|expired|full_waitlist}, departure?: {dates, seatsLeft per showSeatsLeft}} when the feature quote_acceptance and the setting are on.

POST /public/quotation/:token/accept {name, termsAccepted}: 5 per 10 minutes per IP; services/quotes/accept.ts does, in order and idempotently (a second call returns the first result): validity and revocation checks; itinerary approved with accepted_*; lead -> won through the existing status function (source quote_accept, actor null) so automations run; when itineraries.departure_id is set and group_departures is on, requestSeats (R143) with seats_requested or the lead pax and source quote_accept (confirmMode decides held or confirmed; full -> waitlisted and the answer says so); createInvoice per quotes.accept.createInvoice (proforma or invoice from the itinerary, reusing the existing from-itinerary logic); a deposit link through R142 when offerDeposit and a gateway (or the test gateway) is connected, else bank details; event quote.accepted; staff notification and a lead timeline entry.
Staff: an itinerary can be marked accepted by staff (accepted_via staff) for acceptances that arrive by message.

/q/[token]: an 'Accept and book' button (label from settings, through t()), accept-sheet with name and terms checkbox, then the result: accepted (with seats held/confirmed or waitlisted), Pay deposit (opens the payment link) or bank details with the reference; an already-accepted quote shows the accepted state; expired shows no button.
Itinerary page: an 'Accepted by <name> on <date> via link' badge.

tests: backend/test/quote-accept.test.ts: accept marks approved and lead won once (idempotent); expired and revoked refused; feature or setting off -> 404 on accept and no accept block on GET; departure linked -> seats held or confirmed per confirmMode, full -> waitlisted; invoice created per setting; deposit link with the test gateway; bank details otherwise; rate limit; quote.accepted emitted once.

e2e/quote-accept.spec.ts: staff enables accept, shares a quote linked to a departure; an anonymous browser accepts with a name, sees the seats and pays the deposit on the test gateway; staff sees the lead won, the seat booking and the payment.
acceptance: One tap on the quote link closes the loop: lead won, seats handled, invoice and deposit offered.
Agencies that leave the setting off see the quote page as before.
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # 0 failed files; passed >= the count at the last merge
cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit

cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3120 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8807/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/quote-accept.spec.ts e2e/itineraries.spec.ts e2e/web-pages.spec.ts e2e/invoices.spec.ts
productRules: Generic product: no prospect or customer names anywhere.
Feature switch: quote_acceptance plus the agency setting; seat holds also need group_departures and the agency switch.
Public route: tenant from the master quotation_links row first; rate limited; the same not-found answers as today; no data beyond today's projection plus the accept block.
Backend: tenant migration 0063 only; regenerate the bundle; IP stored only as a salted hash.
Desktop: t() with en and nl keys in quotes.json; RTL-safe classes; money and dates through lib/format.ts and lib/dates.ts.
Never weaken, skip or delete an existing test.
